# Clockgogo | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning in one sentence | Low-cost, mobile priority cloud duty and field worksheet products, reduced cards through GPS, face and CWS. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | Core is attendance rather than a full set of HCM/pays; location and face data requires PDPO notification and minimization; data retention and API frequency needs confirmation. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | The core is attendance rather than a full set of HCM/pays; location and face data require PDPO notification and minimization; data retention and API frequency need confirmation. |
